result.topic_en: Riemann sets up the problem of finding a function of the complex variable z = x + iy, defined in a plane domain, whose imaginary part vanishes on given circles and which has prescribed logarithmic-type behaviour, connected to Dirichlet-type integrals and the Laplace equation.

items.english: To determine a function of a variable complex quantity, for all values represented geometrically by points of a plane lying [outside] given circles, such that its real part on the boundary is arbitrarily given.
